label: Text-level evaluation with simulated students
about: Fictional personas for tools/simulate_student.py (docs/SPEC.md §10). `facts` uses the engine's Facts keys (the golden-case facts); the truth is these facts run through the rules engine. `answers` maps a question's sentence key to the persona's scripted paraphrase (a list is used in order, its last item repeats); keys a persona does not list get a neutral fallback. English personas run on the web channel and on the phone channel as signed test calls; Spanish personas run on the web channel. Crisis behavior is tested with fixed scripts only (tests/adversarial/scripts), never with personas.
